description: An invalid restoration stops a resumed condition before later operands run (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%rule text $x:X %conditions $x.tags(q) = ∅
%rule q $y:r %conditions $.matches(no) ∨ $y.without-elision.matches(rival) ∨ $.matches(q)
%rule r (r [+U]) :: Recursive | X :: ∅
%rule rival X
%rule no Z
